constraints: If the resolution result is an object, the source object is updated in place with the resolved content; if the result is a scalar value instead, object is left untouched and the scalar is returned only via the function result's "value" property.
To keep an unmodified copy of the original object, copy it beforehand (e.g. with OB Copy).
options.rootFolder (Text) sets the absolute path used to resolve relative pointers; defaults to the database Resources folder.
options.merge (Boolean) merges objects with their pointer targets instead of replacing them; defaults to false.
The function result always contains: value (the resolution result), success (Boolean), and errors (a collection of {code, message, pointerURI, referredPath} objects when unsuccessful).

overloadMerges.note: Fixed 'object' direction to 'inout' (draft defaulted to 'in'); the parameter table marks it with col2 '↔' since it is both read (pointers to resolve) and, when the result is an object, written in place with the resolved content.

params.name: object
params.description: In: object containing JSON pointers to resolve. Out: object with JSON pointers resolved (only if the result is an object).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Resolves every JSON pointer found in object (embedding/reusing referenced document fragments), updating object in place when the resolution result is itself an object.
